source: class Coin { public int Value=7; }
class Lists { public List<List<int>> Values=[]; }
class Maps { public Dictionary<string,List<int>> Values={}; }
class SetMaps { public Dictionary<string,Set<int>> Values={}; }
class DeepMaps { public Dictionary<string,List<List<int>>> Values={}; }
class Deep { public List<List<List<int>>> Values=[]; }
class ClassLists { public List<List<Coin>> Values=[]; }
class Probe {
public static int DictionaryAlias() { Maps h=new(); var a=[3]; h.Values.Add("a",a); a.Add(4); return h.Values["a"].Count*10+a.Count; }

public static int DictionarySecondOwner() { Maps h=new(); Maps b=new(); var a=[3]; h.Values.Add("a",a); try { b.Values.Add("a",a); } catch(string e) { return h.Values.Count*10+b.Values.Count; } return -1; }
public static int DictionarySetAlias() { SetMaps h=new(); var a=[3].ToSet(); h.Values.Add("a",a); h.Values["a"].Add(4); return h.Values["a"].Count*10+a.Count; }
public static int DictionaryNestedAlias() { DeepMaps h=new(); var a=[3]; h.Values.Add("a",[a]); a.Add(4); return h.Values["a"][0].Count; }
public static int DictionaryDuplicateFresh() { DeepMaps h=new(); var a=[3]; try { h.Values.Add("a",[a,a]); } catch(string e) { return h.Values.Count*10+a.Count; } return -1; }
public static int EmptyListDistinct() { Lists h=new(); List<int> a=[]; List<int> b=[]; h.Values.Add(a); h.Values.Add(b); a.Add(3); return h.Values[0].Count*100+h.Values[1].Count*10+b.Count; }
public static int EmptyListDuplicate() { Deep h=new(); List<int> a=[]; try { h.Values.Add([a,a]); } catch(string e) { return h.Values.Count; } return -1; }

public static int RetainedNestedAfterSecondRemoval() { Deep h=new(); var a=[3]; var m=[a]; h.Values.Add(m); h.Values.Clear(); m.Add([5]); m.RemoveAt(0); a.Add(4); return m.Count*100+m[0][0]*10+a.Count; }
public static int ClosureInsertedList() { Lists h=new(); var a=[3]; NeoDelegate<int> read=()=>a.Count; h.Values.Add(a); h.Values[0].Add(4); return read(); }
public static int ClosureRetainedNested() { Deep h=new(); var a=[3]; var m=[a]; NeoDelegate<int> read=()=>m[0].Count; h.Values.Add(m); h.Values.Clear(); a.Add(4); return read(); }

public static int RepeatedSecondOwnerFailures() { Lists h=new(); Lists other=new(); var a=[3]; h.Values.Add(a); int errors=0; for(int i=0;i<16;i++){try { other.Values.Add(a); } catch(string e) {errors+=1;} } a.Add(4); return errors*100+h.Values[0].Count*10+other.Values.Count; }

public static int RetainedClassNestedDuplicate() { ClassLists h=new(); Coin c=new(); var a=[c]; h.Values.Add(a); h.Values.Clear(); ClassLists other=new(); try { other.Values.Add([c]); } catch(string e) { c.Value=9; return a[0].Value; } return -1; }

public static int GrownPrebuiltAliasSecondOwner() { Lists h=new(); Deep other=new(); var leaf=[3]; var before=[leaf]; leaf.Add(4); h.Values.Add(leaf); try { other.Values.Add(before); } catch(string e) { return h.Values[0].Count*10+other.Values.Count; } return -1; }
public static int GrownPrebuiltAliasStaysLive() { Deep h=new(); var leaf=[3]; var before=[leaf]; leaf.Add(4); h.Values.Add(before); leaf.Add(5); return h.Values[0][0].Count*10+leaf.Count; }

public static int GrownPrebuiltAliasLateFailureRetry() { Lists owner=new(); Deep h=new(); var busy=[9]; var first=[busy]; busy.Add(10); owner.Values.Add(busy); var fresh=[3]; try { h.Values.Add([fresh,first[0]]); } catch(string e) {fresh.Add(4); h.Values.Add([fresh]); return owner.Values[0].Count*100+h.Values[0][0].Count*10+fresh.Count;} return -1; }

public static int GrownPrebuiltClassListSecondOwner() { ClassLists h=new(); ClassLists other=new(); Coin c=new(); var leaf=[c]; var before=[leaf]; leaf.Add(new()); h.Values.Add(leaf); try { other.Values.Add(before[0]); } catch(string e) {return h.Values[0].Count*10+other.Values.Count;} return -1; }

public static int GrownNestedDuplicateSnapshots() { Deep h=new(); var leaf=[3]; var before=[leaf]; leaf.Add(4); try { h.Values.Add([before[0],leaf]); } catch(string e) { return h.Values.Count; } return -1; }

public static int GrownPrebuiltAliasPublishedSecondOwner() { Lists h=new(); Deep other=new(); var leaf=[3]; var before=[leaf]; leaf.Add(4); h.Values.Add(leaf); int forced=h.Values[0][0]; try { other.Values.Add(before); } catch(string e) { return h.Values[0].Count*10+other.Values.Count; } return -1; }
public static int GrownLocalNestedAlias() { var leaf=[3]; var before=[leaf]; leaf.Add(4); return before[0].Count*10+leaf.Count; }
public static int GrownLocalDirectAlias() { var leaf=[3]; var before=leaf; leaf.Add(4); return before.Count*10+leaf.Count; }

public static int GrownDirectAliasSecondOwner() { Lists h=new(); Lists other=new(); var leaf=[3]; var before=leaf; leaf.Add(4); h.Values.Add(leaf); try {other.Values.Add(before);}catch(string e){return h.Values[0].Count*10+other.Values.Count;}return -1; }
